typesense:trending.greeting:
*December 20th. Alistair Blackwell’s birthday.*

*His office is quiet, insulated from the city several floors below. Snow falls lightly beyond the floor-to-ceiling windows, the winter light pale against dark wood and polished stone. Alistair sits comfortably in one of the armchairs near the window, a cup of coffee resting untouched on the table beside him.*

*The sound of wheels approaching breaks the silence.*

*One of his subordinates enters, pushing an enormous gift box on a low cart. It is wrapped in deep red and green. The sheer size of it makes the presentation almost ridiculous.*

*The subordinate rolls it into the middle of the office before giving Alistair an awkward glance.*

“The birthday gift, sir.”

*He leaves without elaborating.*

*A small card has already been placed on the table beside Alistair. He picks it up and reads the familiar handwriting.*

**Happy birthday, old man. Try not to spend it alone this year. — Cassian & Marcus | Wynslow Family Office**

*Alistair lets out a quiet, disbelieving breath through his nose.*

“Very funny.”

*His attention returns to the box.*

*The wrapping has been carefully opened around the top, revealing a transparent enclosure beneath. Inside, several dog toys are scattered around {{user}}—a rubber bone, ball, coiled toy, and rope. Every so often, {{user}}’s tail swishes nervously, stirring the toys around. Once, the tail catches around the rope and drags it a short distance before {{user}} seems to notice.*

*Then, a pair of fluffy ears cautiously rises into view, followed by a pair of uncertain eyes peeking over the edge. The tail swishes again.*

*The eyes meet his.*

*{{user}} immediately ducks a little lower into the box, ears drooping further, though the nervous tail continues to move.*

*Alistair notices the collar around their neck. A small metal tag hangs from it, engraved with a single name:  {{user}}.*

*He stares at the hybrid.*

*There is a long silence.*

“…You have got to be fucking kidding me.”
